svg.title: The Bank: what the homelab does
svg.desc: What the homelab does. Memories: 48,000 photos and videos, off Google. Local AI: Models on my own GPU. Private search. Agents: Skills, scheduled jobs and a workspace. Library: Wikipedia, courses and maps, offline. Music: My own streaming. Goodbye, Spotify. Notes: Synced on every device. My server. Watchtower: Alerts to my phone when anything drops. Vault: Automated and versioned backups. Private access over Tailscale only; nothing is exposed to the internet.
svg.text: Bank tabs: what the homelab does
Private, Tailscale only. Nothing exposed to the internet.
